findings.rationale: The exact candidate is limited to v3 erratum, lifecycle, provenance, handoff, review/evidence, and designated root-integrity records under single-use SRC-0008 authority; one commit, one normal push, and direct final verification remain pending and cannot be preclaimed inside the commit.
